                    RULES AND REGULATIONS OF THE COLLEGE

                      CLASS ATTENDANCE OF STUDENTS

    ➢    It is obligatory on part of every student to attend a minimum of 75%
         of the total classes held in each subject in an academic session.

    ➢    Class attendance of the students will be checked from time to time.
         Any student who fails to obtain the minimum of 75% attendance
         will be declared dis-collegiate and will forfeit his/her seat.




                       COLLEGE RULES AND DISCIPLINE

➢       Students are expected to maintain a high standard of
        discipline both within and outside the college premises.
➢       College uniform is compulsory for students during teaching
        and Examinations days and on all important occasions like
        Freshers’ Day, Youth Festival, Foundation Day etc.
➢       Jackets, Jeans or T-shirts, Leggings are not a part of the dress
        code.

➢       Students must carry their Identity Card to the college
        regularly.

➢       Use of mobile phones inside the college campus is strictly
        prohibited.

➢       Students must take proper care of the college property. Strict
        action will be taken against those caught damaging the same.
➢       Smoking and chewing of paan masala are not allowed
        inside the college campus. Students caught spitting in the
        classrooms, toilet or staircases will be severely punished. A
        mass penalty of Rs. 500/- will also be imposed for such acts of
        gross indiscipline.
                         INTERNAL EXAMINATION

 ➢   There will be compulsory Tests / Sessional Examination for
     all classes.
 ➢   Students are required to secure at least 30% aggregate
     marks in the Unit Test/ Sessional Examination in order to
     qualify for the Final Examination. Admit cards will not be
     issued to those who fail to obtain the desired percentage of
     marks.
